Lina (Finance): Sirius Health reporting a burst line stacked on top of their reserved commit for 2026-07-04 07:40-07:55 UTC. They claim identical work billed twice. Rafael can you pull the invoice?
Rafael (Billing): Looking at INV-2026-1133. There is a reserved commit row and a burst row referencing nodepool sirius-prod-8 with overlapping minute buckets.
Zoe (CS): Customer says they saw a single spike during a small failover window. They expected the reserved pool to cover it.
Hank (Ops): Pulling metering export now. If the metrics pipeline replayed a batch due to transient ETL error we could have duplicate meter samples.
billing-bot: Auto-scan: INV-2026-1133 shows identical meter_ids in reserved_bucket and burst_bucket for sirius-prod-8. Recommended manual reconciliation.
Lina (Finance): Please attach the metering CSV for sirius-prod-8 07:30-08:00 UTC and give us a duplicated token estimate.
Hank (Ops): Exported. Small excerpt: ```
2026-07-04T07:42:18Z sirius-prod-8 reserved_bucket tokens=8,640 meter_id=mi-zz77
2026-07-04T07:42:18Z sirius-prod-8 burst_bucket tokens=8,640 meter_id=mi-zz77
```
Zoe (CS): That meter_id match confirms double-count. Sirius finance already escalated. We should offer interim relief.
Nora (AcctMgr): Agreed. Hank, any idea on root cause and timeline to fix?
Hank (Ops): Root cause: metrics ETL retried an ingest job and the dedupe layer missed a sequence-tag for a narrow time window. Patch merged to the ETL deduper and deployed 2026-07-05 02:20 UTC (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/etl/pull/2798). Full audit CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-billing-audits/2026-07/sirius-dup-2509876543.csv
Lina (Finance): Duplicate tokens ~8,640 which is about $68. Propose provisional credit $95 to cover rounding/tax and offer a 2-day waived burst allowance plus a one-time 1.5% SLA credit on next committed invoice as goodwill. Approve?
Rafael (Billing): I can create a provisional credit memo once Nora approves. Will tag as provisional_credit and hold final adjustment until the full audit is complete and any vendor notes are correlated.
Nora (AcctMgr): Approved. Please proceed with provisional credit $95 and draft the customer message for review. Keep language simple and emphasize the remedial action.
Zoe (CS): I'll prepare a plain-English note: "We've applied a provisional credit of $95 to your invoice and are completing an audit. We'll follow up with a final reconciliation within 7 business days." Nora will review before sending.
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-3901 created: "Sirius Health duplicate metering - provisional credit issued" assigned to Rafael.
Hank (Ops): Reached out to cloud-metering@oraclecloud.com; they confirmed duplicate export rows for the instance due to an attach retry coinciding with our ETL replay. They're correlating logs.
Rafael (Billing): Created credit memo CM-2026-PROV-774 and applied provisional credit to INV-2026-1133 on 2026-07-12. billing_note=etl_replay_duplicate_sample.
Lina (Finance): Thanks. Please mark invoice INV-2026-1133 as under_review and update BILL-3901 with the audit link.
Rafael (Billing): Done. Invoice under_review and audit CSV linked. Will post final adj after Ops confirms reconciliation.
Nora (AcctMgr): Once provider confirms, I'll sign off on final customer communication. For now we have provisional relief in place.
Lina (Finance): Great work everyone. Marking this thread resolved when final reconciliation is posted.
Rafael (Billing): Noted — provisional credit applied; will update ticket with final numbers once audit complete.
Lina (Finance): Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:"
